text.tspan: Three stages, one data flow. None of them changes the original array; each returns a new value.
reduce, unrolled: the accumulator is just carried forward
Always pass reduce a starting value. Without it, reduce uses the first element as the seed, and throws on an empty array.
These return new values, so they chain. forEach does not: it returns undefined and exists only for side effects.
